thesis: Tesla remains primarily an automotive company by revenue, but its economics increasingly extend beyond vehicle sales through energy storage, services, charging and software-oriented investments. In 2025, the energy generation and storage segment grew rapidly and carried a materially higher gross margin than the automotive and services segment, making Tesla's non-car businesses increasingly important to the company's overall story.

facts.claim: Tesla reported $94.827 billion of total revenue in 2025, including $69.526 billion of automotive revenue, $12.771 billion of energy generation and storage revenue, and $12.530 billion of services and other revenue.
Tesla's energy generation and storage revenue rose 27% in 2025 to $12.771 billion, while the segment's gross margin increased to 29.8% from 26.2% in 2024.

Tesla's services and other revenue increased 19% in 2025, driven in part by paid Supercharging sessions, non-warranty maintenance and collision revenue, used-vehicle sales and automotive insurance revenue.
Tesla spent $6.411 billion on research and development in 2025, up 41% from 2024, as it continued investing in AI, software, manufacturing and future products.
Tesla produced 1,654,667 vehicles and delivered 1,636,129 vehicles in 2025, while energy storage deployments reached 46.7 GWh for the year.
facts.source_title: Tesla Fourth Quarter 2025 Production, Deliveries & Deployments

facts.claim: In Q4 2025, Tesla deployed 14.2 GWh of energy storage products, which the company described as a quarterly deployment record.
facts.source_title: Tesla Fourth Quarter 2025 Production, Deliveries & Deployments

facts.claim: Tesla said its energy generation and storage business reached a record $1.1 billion of quarterly gross profit in Q4 2025 and that it planned Megapack 3 and Megablock production at Megafactory Houston in 2026.

Tesla's Megapack is designed for commercial and utility-scale storage projects, while Powerwall is a rechargeable home battery product; Tesla said the one-millionth Powerwall was built and installed in 2025.
facts.source_title: Tesla Megapack Product Details and Powerwall Support
